objective: Convert full DAG refutations in the characteristic-two syntactic polynomial-resolution calculus, through a compiler-style signed-literal and constant substitution, with a polynomial node bound independent of disjunction width and explicit bit-work costs.
status: Proved: Signed-variable and constant substitution transports every syntactic degree-two polynomial-resolution DAG through exact compiler projections with at most twice as many source nodes for duplicate-free source clauses. Work in the explicit proof encoding is polynomial.
title: Transport of syntactic deductions with degree-two multiplication
